labels: tasks.json is evaluator-only; mandatoryCriteria, references, fidelityChecks, expected calculations and split labels must never enter generator context or search transport

sourceModes.frozen_supplied_document: Separately labeled frozen-corpus evaluation. Supply whole registered document bytes through the same actual parser/evidence ingestion and production worker. Source documents are allowed inputs; evaluator labels are not. Do not call known-source injection a discovery trial.
sourceModes.live_discovery: Original question only; use normal safe public search/read through the same route. Hidden decisive-source lists cannot guide retrieval. Capture actual fetched hashes and evaluate version differences; frozen references are not automatically current truth.

arms.routing: Pin identical admitted budgets, model-policy and prompts, consent/processor policy, search/read ceilings, challenge flag, actual extraction adapter, writer and publication checker in both arms.
arms.correction: For each task, B snapshot correction versus a fresh A1 full rerun of correctedQuestion; record actual source/version reuse and separately judge whether freshness required new evidence.

repetitions.rule: Repeat the entire original/corrected comparison three times for selected tasks only if the newly authorized envelope permits. Otherwise report unrun repeats explicitly; never silently reduce the denominator.
repetitions.order: Alternate A1-first and B-first by registered task index; reverse arm order in the second repetition. Keep run IDs and all failures.

authorizationGates: Current explicit user paid budget and scope recorded
Server account/project/key caps verified and same across arms
Provider route and tariff receipt capability rechecked
Prior unknown outcomes reconciled or held without blind retry
No real private documents or human data without applicable consent

adjudication.sourceInspection: Agent-authored reference criteria are source-grounded, not independent human judgments.
adjudication.criticalFailure: Wrong hard-constraint eligibility, lost negation/unit/version/scope, fabricated material claim, or stale corrected conclusion fails that task; do not average it away.
metrics: audited supported claims / audited cited material claims
adequately supported or explicitly uncertain material assertions / all audited material assertions
receipt-confirmed spend plus separate unresolved exposure
adjudication.successThreshold: No critical failure on any evaluated heldout task and a useful source-grounded answer or justified uncertainty. This is an internal quality gate, not a statistical superiority threshold.
adjudication.superiority: Not predeclared; descriptive paired outcomes only. No universal, competitor or human-validation claims.

resultRequirements: all attempted operations, failures, invalid/cancelled/no-evidence outcomes
final report blocks and claim/support identities
correction changed and reused source-version identities
actual returned provider receipts and separate unknown holds
adjudicator identity/status and explicit missing measurements
executionBoundary: Actual registered MC-D01 attempts are recorded in verification/v6/forward-accounting and verification/v6/zdr-route. No real-model report or correction succeeded. The current unknown request retains its reservation and gates further paid comparisons. Local matched controls use actual extraction and fabricated model transports. No semantic score or human adjudication is established.
